author: Fusion VR
title: Hiring mid and senior 3D character modeling artists
content: We’re Hiring: Mid & Senior 3D Character Modeling Artists. Bring characters to life at FusionVR! We’re looking for talented 3D Character Modeling Artists who can take ownership of characters from sculpting through modeling, texturing, shading, grooming, and MetaHuman / Unreal Engine integration for cinematic, real-time, and immersive experiences. Role responsibilities include translating the director’s vision into character designs, creating hyper-realistic and stylized characters from concept to final delivery, handling modeling, sculpting, retopology, UVs, texturing, shading, and grooming, preparing characters for MetaHuman / Unreal Engine, and delivering presentation-ready characters. Requirements: mid-level minimum 5 years, senior-level minimum 10 years; strong portfolio in likeness sculpting, realistic/stylized characters, creature design, texturing, and grooming; proficiency in Maya, Blender, and Unreal Engine. Contact: application form linked in the first comment of the post.
